[A5]did we become these sin-
king stones? When
did we build this bro-
[E5]ken home? [D5]
[A5]Holding each other like ran-
som notes Drop
ping our hearts to grip
[E5]our brother's [D5]throats

[C5]low, beneath your own sha-
[G5]dow Stuck inside, half alive Do you
[F5]ever stop to ask yourself why?
[A5]Close your mind, identify Do you
[C5]feel, do you feel? Do you call this a
[G5]life? All you waited for
[E5]Drowning just to keep score We

[Bridge]
[F5]always start with good
intentions But
[G5]lose ourselves along
the way

it go

us home
[A5]Singing the song that's [G5]inside
us all
[E5]If we don't open our [F5]eyes
we're

[A5]

ourselves
Bitter blood builds our pris-
[E5]on cell [D5]

our lungs
Depths of our heart have blacked
[E5]the sun [D5]

intentions But lose

us all

[Interlude]
[A5]Naked we
come, naked
we leave Fools
we are,
to hold
tightly

We are
free

Inside us all,
